topography.project_purpose: Farm. Structurally: 25 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (targetwhitelisting, rebalancingconfig, accessroles). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
